lenses.name: Neighborhood density
lenses.description: Population per km² from the 2022 IRIS statistical partition, aggregated to map hexes. Communes not divided into IRIS are whole-commune pseudo-IRIS; whole units are assigned by centroid, so this is much finer than department density but still approximate at hex boundaries.

lenses.name: Neighborhood seniors
lenses.description: Residents aged 65 or older as a share of residents in the 2022 IRIS statistical partition, population-weighted within map hexes. Excludes Mayotte.

lenses.name: Neighborhood immigration
lenses.description: Immigrants as a share of residents in the 2022 IRIS statistical partition, population-weighted within map hexes. INSEE defines an immigrant as a person born abroad who was not born a French national. Excludes Mayotte.

lenses.name: Neighborhood youth
lenses.description: Residents under 20 as a share of residents in the 2022 IRIS statistical partition, population-weighted within map hexes. Excludes Mayotte.
